title: No Way Back 002: Better Ways Forward Through Music and Subculture Stories, 1979–1997

description.main: The second issue of No Way Back, a magazine reprinting 1979–1997 music and subculture journalism and photography from The Face, i-D, Mixmag, Collusion and other titles. 208 pages, released April 2026.
description.extended:
No Way Back 002 is the second issue of a printed magazine that reprints period journalism and photography on music, clubs and subculture from 1979 to 1997.

The issue gathers pieces from The Face, i-D, Time Out, Village Voice, Rolling Stone, Mixmag, The Observer and David Toop's Collusion. It also reproduces photographs and covers and spreads from the original titles. Steven Harvey's 1983 Collusion feature covers the New York disco underground. Steve Eichner photographed the club kids at The Limelight, Palladium, Tunnel and Club USA. Sheryl Garratt reported from Chicago for The Face in 1986, Jon Savage spent a night at Jive Turkey in Sheffield, and Kodwo Eshun wrote on jungle for i-D in 1994, with jungle images from Eddie Otchere. The editors add notes and playlists. It runs 208 pages at 165 × 240 mm and went on sale in April 2026.

The first issue, NWB001, covered 1977 to 1989. This one moves the span to 1979–1997 and keeps the focus on moments in dance music, hip-hop and pop, with parallel shifts in art, design and fashion. The publisher describes the material as culture recorded in the moment, before later interpretation settled over it. The issue carries ISSN 2977-8530 and no ISBN.

notes: Issue 2 (NWB002) of No Way Back, subtitled Learning From, Not Longing For, The Past. ISSN 2977-8530; the barcode is 9772977853002 and there is no ISBN.
